reason: pays_strangers. The address is a liquidator contract, not a wallet: it calls Aave V3 liquidationCall (0x00a718a9 on Pool 0x87870bca3f3fd6335c3f4ce8392d69350b4fa4e2) and Morpho Blue liquidate, taking the liquidation bonus in the same transaction, funded by an unlock/unlockCallback flash loan and paying for it out of the bonus. A fresh address calling the same function gets the same bonus (no role), so the job is open; what it is not is a fee-for-call keeper reward - the pay is the seized-collateral spread, and the positions are contested by whoever watches them.
